description.value: The Quality Inn Waddling Dog is a charming Tudor-style hotel positioned just minutes from the BC Ferries Swartz Bay terminal, Victoria International Airport, and Butchart Gardens—making it a natural staging point for cyclists arriving or departing Vancouver Island. The property houses the award-winning Waddling Dog Pub and an onsite beer, wine, and spirits store, so food and drinks are steps away after a long day in the saddle. It is dog-friendly and includes a complimentary hot breakfast each morning.

address.value: 2476 Mt. Newton X Road, Saanichton, British Columbia V8M 2B8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and confirms this is an active, operating Tudor-style hotel at 2476 Mt. Newton X Road in Saanichton (OSM lists the community as Sidney—a discrepancy flagged below). The /amenities page explicitly lists vending machines, free high-speed Wi-Fi, and an onsite restaurant/pub; the /dining page confirms the Waddling Dog Pub serves lunch and dinner on-site. No bike storage policy, bike-in-room option, or any cycling-specific services are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Sidney' but the website consistently shows the address as 'Saanichton, British Columbia V8M 2B8'; postal code V8M confirms Saanichton, not Sidney—the community field in OSM should be corrected.
The /dining page notes that pub and liquor store hours have 'temporarily changed' and asks guests to call for current hours, which may indicate reduced or irregular operations.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel confirmed by a fully functional website with complete contact details, room listings, and amenity descriptions. Its proximity to the Swartz Bay ferry terminal makes it directly relevant to touring cyclists travelling to or from Vancouver Island.

Nearby evening food.detail: Onsite Waddling Dog Pub serves lunch and dinner; /dining page describes pub food, pints, and comfort dishes with a west coast twist

Vending machines.detail: Explicitly listed under Hotel Amenities on /amenities page: 'Vending Machine'
